Subject: Kickoff: vendor credential collection & PO routing for LumenWave

Hi Sofia / LumenWave onboarding team —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor setup with Redwood Inference. To get the vendor record created and enable PO issuance + payment routing, we need the information below. If you can return items 1–7 within 5 business days that will keep us on track for an early December PO.

Required items (minimum):
- Legal entity name (exact as registered) and DBA if applicable
- Registered address and remit-to address (if different)
- Tax ID: US EIN or non-US VAT/GST where applicable; indicate entity classification (US corp, foreign entity, branch)
- W-9 or W-8BEN/W-8BEN-E (as applicable) or local tax documentation
- Bank remit details for ACH + wire: bank name, ABA/routing (ACH), account number (last 4 ok for initial email), SWIFT/BIC for wires, beneficiary name, bank address
- Remittance contact (name + email) and billing email for invoice receipt
- Company contact for PO questions (name + phone/email)

Optional but helpful:
- Voided check or bank verification letter (for ACH)
- Corporate registration or certificate of incorporation (for entity verification)
- VAT registration / foreign tax registration documents (if non-US)

PO and invoicing notes:
- Standard Redwood terms are Net 30 unless contracted otherwise.
- Invoices must reference the PO number we issue and include line-level descriptions and any applicable tax.
- If you expect invoices for subcontractors, list the subcontractor legal names and we will require them on the PO or separate vendor records.

I attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable) and PO_template.xlsx (example PO). Please fill the form and return to me and cc ap@redwood.com.

If you'd prefer a short call to walk through the form, I'm happy to schedule one — I've cc'd Markus and Vanessa from procurement who will support activation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, PO_template.xlsx

Appreciate the checklist — attaching a preliminary filled vendor data PDF (lumenwave_vendor_data.pdf). A couple of quick clarifications before we finalize:

1) PO references for services: we usually list prime contractor + subcontractors on the invoice. Do you need subcontractors listed as separate vendors in Redwood, or is a line-item note on the invoice sufficient?
2) Tax withholding: LumenWave is a UK parent with a US branch. We will likely submit a W-8BEN-E for the UK entity; does Redwood apply any US withholding for non-US invoices?
3) Bank details: we can provide ACH for our US branch; for the UK parent we will provide SWIFT instructions. Do you have a preferred wire beneficiary naming convention?

We will attach the completed form and a scanned bank confirmation (we can provide a bank letter) by tomorrow.

Attached: lumenwave_vendor_data.pdf

Thanks, Sofia — that looks good as a start. Quick answers and a few follow-ups:

- Subcontractors: we prefer separate vendor records for any third party getting paid directly; if the subcontractor is paid via LumenWave on your invoice, a line-item note is okay but we may request additional docs for high-value pass-throughs.
- Withholding: for services invoiced to Redwood US, we follow US tax rules — a valid W-8BEN-E typically prevents withholding for most invoice types but we'd coordinate with tax counsel for cross-border services. Please attach the completed W-8 and any VAT registration files.
- Beneficiary naming: please provide legal account holder name exactly as the bank shows it. For wires include SWIFT and bank address; for ACH include ABA and account type (checking/savings).
- For ACH verification we need either a voided check or a bank letter on bank letterhead confirming the account number and owner.

I'll add a hard deadline of COB Monday, 30 Nov, to receive the bank letter + completed tax form so we can issue a PO next week.

I've looped in Ben from AP to own the PO creation once vendor is active. Ben — when the vendor record is created please set PO routing to invoices@redwood-payments.com and use Net 30 standard terms. Markus / Vanessa — let me know if any additional compliance checks are needed for a UK parent.

Attaching sample_wire_letter.docx we accept for verification.

-M

Attachments: sample_wire_letter.docx
